title: Member Terms — Replacement Fee on Reissued Capital Credit Checks
content:
# Replacement Fee on Reissued Capital Credit Checks

**Member terms — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** The replacement fee is counted from the voided check entries on the account: where they number no more than the class's free reissue count the replacement is free; where they number exactly one more than that count, the class's reissue fee is deducted; where they number more than that, $25.00 is deducted.

The free reissue count is 1 and the reissue fee is $15.00 in every patron class, so:

| Voided check entries on the capital account | Replacement fee deducted |
|---|---|
| 1 (or none) | none — free |
| 2 | $15.00 |
| 3 or more | $25.00 |

**What is counted.** Every void entry on the capital account, whatever the reason for the void — stale-dated, lost or returned undeliverable — and whichever payout it voided.

**Where the fee goes.** The fee is deducted from the face of the replacement check and is recorded among the charges deducted from it.

## Hypothetical cases

1. A member's first check was voided as stale-dated and is now replaced: one void on the account, no fee.
2. That replacement was itself returned undeliverable and voided: two voids on the account, $15.00 is deducted from the next replacement.
3. A third void on the same account: three voids, $25.00 is deducted.
